title: OpenClaw vs Zapier: Why Autonomous Agents Beat Workflow Automation
summary: OpenClaw vs Zapier: autonomous AI agents decide their own steps; Zapier runs predefined rules. See which wins for your use case — and when to use both.
body_markdown: Not for everything. Zapier is the right tool for deterministic trigger-action automation — data syncs, notifications, CRM workflows — where every step is known in advance. OpenClaw handles tasks requiring judgment: research, content creation, code review, adaptive decision-making. Most teams run both. With Blink Claw from about $45/month per agent, you can run OpenClaw alongside your existing Zapier workflows without managing any infrastructure.
